title: Baseball Stadium
content: So this dream really got to me. I was in a stadium watching what seemed to be a baseball game, strapped to a chair like a roller coaster. In front of me and to the right, there was a machine with a telescopic arm that was hovering over the crowd, it's arm slowly moving around. I was terrified that the arm of the machine was going to cause structural damage by knocking out a load bearing pillar. I was sitting next to a lady who I've seen in my dreams before, but this time with over a dozen of her friends. I was feeling amorous, even though I was terrified of the machine destroying the stadum. I got up from my seat and was socializing with some people, until she said "I moved your Mountain Dew over there.." After that I end up being in what looked like a hospital hallway trying to find a toilet. There was a stray toilet in the hallway but I didn't think it was appropriate, so I went looking for the bathroom. I end up in one of those iconic Mall World bathrooms where there's a bunch of toilets and sinks everywhere. I started to do my business, but then everyone started running in a panic, except one guy who said hello and patted me on the back. I end up in an open stairwell covered in what I thought was snow. At this point I realized I was in a city that I was unfamiliar with and was looking for a ride home, and figured I would ask one of the baseball teams if I can take their buss home with them. The guy that patted me on the back in the bathrooms was there and had a chuckle. I then realized it wasn't snowing, but the residue was from the stadium collapsing!! This was days ago and I'm still thinking about it.
